name: Hidden Channels
description: DEPRECATED. Allows you to see the name and description of channels you don't have actually access to.
author: xirreal

site.longDescription:
**Discord finally got off their ass and decided to fix this blatant oversight in their permissions API.**

Exposes hidden channels, adding a cute little red lock next to them! Updated: now using 100% ethically sourced SolidJS-React bridges!
